pagedata.pyBrowseSQL: SELECT b.claimno AS "CaseID", b.nopolis AS "NoKTP", b.qqname AS "ClaimID", b.picteknik AS "Conveyance", b.businessname AS "ClaimNo", b.leader_member AS "UserTeknisEmail", CASE WHEN b.grouppanel in ('003','009') THEN (select occupationid from pooldata.t_anekalist where nopolis=b.nopolis and prodke=b.prodke and indexobject=a.objectid and rownum=1) WHEN b.grouppanel='006' THEN (SELECT cc.OccupationCode FROM pooldata.t_propertylist z, JSON_TABLE (z.OCCUPATIONLIST, '$' COLUMNS (NESTED PATH '$.OccupationList[*]' COLUMNS (OccupationCode varchar2 path '$.OccupationCode'))) cc WHERE z.nopolis=b.nopolis and z.INDEXOBJECT=a.objectid and z.prodke=b.prodke and rownum='1') ELSE (select goodsid from pooldata.t_cargolist where nopolis=b.nopolis and prodke=b.prodke and goodsid=a.objectid and rownum='1') END AS "UserTeknis", CASE WHEN b.grouppanel in ('003','009') THEN (select occupationname from pooldata.t_anekalist where nopolis=b.nopolis and prodke=b.prodke and indexobject=a.objectid and rownum=1) WHEN b.grouppanel='006' THEN (SELECT dd.OccupationName FROM pooldata.t_propertylist x, JSON_TABLE (x.OCCUPATIONLIST, '$' COLUMNS (NESTED PATH '$.OccupationList[*]' COLUMNS (OccupationName varchar2 path '$.OccupationName'))) dd WHERE x.nopolis=b.nopolis and x.INDEXOBJECT=a.objectid and x.prodke=b.prodke and rownum='1') ELSE (select goodsname from pooldata.t_cargolist where nopolis=b.nopolis and prodke=b.prodke and goodsid=a.objectid and rownum='1') END AS "UserName", to_char(c.begindate,'rrrr') as "Remark", to_char(c.begindate,'dd/mm/yyyy') as "RCV_ID", to_char(c.enddate,'dd/mm/yyyy') as "RW", to_char(b.dateofloss,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "CountryID", to_char(b.registerdate,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "Country", to_char(a.analyst_tfkomitedate,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "Email", to_char(a.ACCEPTANCE_DATECOMITEE,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "District", to_char(a.tglakseptasi,'dd/mm/yyyy') AS "AlasanKlaim", (SELECT CURRENCY FROM pooldata.CURRENCY WHERE ID = A.CURRENCY) AS "NPWP", (SELECT SUM (ESTIMATIONVALUE) FROM pooldata.T_CLAIM_ESTIMASI WHERE claimid = a.claimid AND estimationtype = '1' AND kursid = a.currency) AS "ProdKe", CASE WHEN b.LEADER_MEMBER = 'LEADER' THEN (SELECT SUM (ESTIMATIONVALUE) FROM pooldata.T_CLAIM_ESTIMASI WHERE claimid = a.claimid AND estimationtype = '1' AND kursid = a.currency) - a.GROSSVALUE ELSE (SELECT SUM (ESTIMATIONVALUE) FROM pooldata.T_CLAIM_ESTIMASI WHERE claimid = a.claimid AND estimationtype = '1' AND kursid = a.currency) - a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE END AS "FlagASO", a.noakseptasi as "DistrictID", a.ASM_SHARE AS "ASMShare", a.GROSSVALUE AS "Currency", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE AS "KomiteStatus", a.GROSSVALUE - a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE AS "TKA", CASE WHEN ASM_SHARE = 100 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "Status", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_BPPDAN AS "LossCoverage", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FAC_OUT AS "LokasiSurveyor", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_QS_RI AS "IsTransferPIC", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FSPL AS "AnaylstRemarks", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PSRSPL AS "AnalystDoctorRemaks", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PSPLNSRI AS "NIK", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PSRQS_RI AS "BranchID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FESPL AS "IsAnalisTransfer", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FAC_OBL AS "BranchName", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FACOBSRB AS "BusinessID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_FACOBINDT AS "CASEDB", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_ER1 AS "CauseOfLoss", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_ER2 AS "CauseOfLossID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PSS AS "City", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PRGBI AS "CityID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_PFRA AS "ClientID", a.ASM_SHARE_VALUE * c.PRSN_XL AS "ClientName", case when noakseptasi is null and STATUSAKSEPTASI='1' then 'SUDAH KOMITE' when noakseptasi is null and STATUSAKSEPTASI='0' then 'MENUNGGU KOMITE' END AS "TKI" from pooldata.t_claim_adjustment a, pooldata.t_claim_pnc b, pooldata.pega_dashboardpnc c, datapega.pc_asm_fw_gcnmfw_work d where STATUSAKSEPTASI in ('0','1') and (STATUSAKSEPTASILOD is null or STATUSAKSEPTASILOD!='0') and paymenttype in ('1','2') and a.claimid=b.claimid and b.claimno=c.noklaim and b.claimid=d.pzinskey and (d.pystatuswork NOT IN ('Resolved-Completed', 'Resolved-Rejected') OR d.ISPENDINGCLOSE ='true') and a.noakseptasi is null and b.branchname != 'ASNET' and b.grouppanel in ('003','004','006','009') and b.businesscode NOT IN ('10145', '10168','10165','10164','10053','10075','10126','10011','10077','10007') {ASIS:TempLaporan.UserName} ORDER BY REGISTERDATE DESC
